spots.name: Mount Sentinel

spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Saddle Mountain Lookout
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Skalkaho Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
